title: PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0: human methylarginine site union, analyses and Methylarginine Site Explorer
description: Code, release tables (releases/v1.1.0: 13,358 methylarginine sites and 10 pending, source records, site changes, data dictionary) and the static Methylarginine Site Explorer of PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0. Site positions refer to UniProt release 2026_03 (reviewed human reference proteome UP000005640). Code is MIT; data, figures and text are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see LICENSE.md). The raw downloads behind the inputs are deposited separately (PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0 inputs).
